name: stryker-bun-runner
description: Fast StrykerJS TestRunner plugin for Bun test with JUnit reporting, bail, test filtering, hitLimit protection, and mutant coverage analysis
author: Hugo Felipe Camilo

scripts.mutate: stryker run && bun -e 'const r = await Bun.file("reports/mutation/mutation.json").json(); const all = Object.values(r.files).flatMap(f => f.mutants); const nc = all.filter(m => m.status === "NoCoverage").length; const errs = all.filter(m => m.status === "RuntimeError" || m.status === "CompileError").length; if (nc > 0 || errs > 0) { console.error({ noCoverage: nc, errors: errs }); process.exit(1); }'
scripts.harness: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run build && bun test
